newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Q1 trade surplus widens to $6.74 bln.
newsitem.headline: Russia Q1 trade surplus widens to $6.74 bln.

text.p: Russia posted a trade surplus of $6.74 billion in the first three months of this year after a $5.45 billion surplus in the same period of 1996, the State Statistics Committee said on Tuesday.
Excluding trade with other members of the CIS, the trade surplus over January-March narrowed to $6.17 billion from $5.51 billion.
